rules.quote: Don’t use too many keywords or keywords that are outside the context of the content.
rules.specification: Do not practice keyword stuffing by artificially repeating keywords or injecting off-topic search terms.
rules.violation_condition: content that contains unnatural repetition of keywords ('keyword stuffing') or includes irrelevant keywords outside the context of the page
rules.why: Clear prohibition against keyword stuffing on web content (G-5 distinction: this directly governs text content).
